name: LBA: Palindrome Checker (a, b)
description: Checks whether an input string between markers 'C' and '$' is a palindrome
code:
initial: q_start
final: q_accept
q_start, C, R, q_scan
q_scan, X, R, q_scan
q_scan, Y, R, q_scan
q_scan, a, X, q_match_a_right
q_scan, b, Y, q_match_b_right
q_scan, $, R, q_accept
q_match_a_right, a, R, q_match_a_right
q_match_a_right, b, R, q_match_a_right
q_match_a_right, X, R, q_match_a_right
q_match_a_right, Y, R, q_match_a_right
q_match_a_right, $, L, q_check_a
q_check_a, X, L, q_check_a
q_check_a, Y, L, q_check_a
q_check_a, a, X, q_rewind
q_match_b_right, a, R, q_match_b_right
q_match_b_right, b, R, q_match_b_right
q_match_b_right, X, R, q_match_b_right
q_match_b_right, Y, R, q_match_b_right
q_match_b_right, $, L, q_check_b
q_check_b, X, L, q_check_b
q_check_b, Y, L, q_check_b
q_check_b, b, Y, q_rewind
q_rewind, a, L, q_rewind
q_rewind, b, L, q_rewind
q_rewind, X, L, q_rewind
q_rewind, Y, L, q_rewind
q_rewind, C, R, q_scan
